description: A C# game engine in which a program opens a window, draws each frame with plain static calls named as raylib's functions are, and draws Dear ImGui in the same frame, over SDL3, Vulkan and Slang, with an ECS and source-generated behaviors underneath.
releaseNotes:
The soak check bounds Swarm's entities, like its ids, by the most a whole turn holds at once, since a slow runner's readings of a half can all fall within a turn's fights.
A scene pack's fetch is public with its stages, its progress and a way to stop it, and Sponza's example fetches its pack from a button on its first screen and loads the scene in the same run.
The device shares one sampler for each set of settings among all that ask for it, and closing the window waits for the frames in flight before it frees the buffers a program loaded.
The model passes' loops read their draws by reference, and the script reads their code as compiled for machines of AVX2 and AVX-512 and keeps the listings for the job to upload.
The model passes' record loops copy no view or shadow entry through the CPU's wide registers before the driver's calls, and a script reads their compiled code for it in the Linux job.
A glow light sends from the faces the scene field finds open, read on the GPU where its place or the field near it changes, so a lamp set into a wall lights a probe's hits as the traced reference does.
Every body is blended between its last two steps, its pose remembered before each step whether an entity holds it or not, so a body the flat API makes moves as smoothly as an entity's, with a test of a box made with no entity.
The draws Render gathers name the carrying of the transforms down the tree to run after, so a child mesh is drawn where its parent is in the same frame and one spawned this frame is drawn under it and not at its own transform, with tests of whole frames of an app.
The validation layer's messages of error severity are logged with the words a run's checks look for, which the pinned layer's messages do not carry, so a game, an example, a storm or a native run fails on one again, and a warning, a performance warning or a pool's overrun keeps the layer's words, with a test that holds each check of the scripts and the workflows against the lines as the pinned layer writes them.
The field far out reads as at the origin and alike from run to run, its build taking each mesh's rows against its cascade's corner, its way ahead and far cascade from the camera's eye and far distance, a moving mesh's stamp against the frame's origin and a tie of two meshes as near a cell by bits of the mesh's own, and MoveWorld's words say which meshes it knows by their matrices, that the bodies and sounds move in the call and that any whole step is taken.
A program that moves its world by a whole step says so with MoveWorld, and the engine moves its field, its light, its histories, its shadows' texels, its probes, particles, bodies and sounds with it.
Mapped memory is handed out as a span that can be written and not read, each view a pass draws through is pushed and found once a pass, and stereo eyes, projections set through rlgl, the modeling window's outlines, the shadow casters' ranking, rays met against meshes, the pointer's picking and the glow lights' boxes keep their precision far from the world's origin.
Global illumination writes its lamps into the sixteen entries its kernels' array holds, the point and spot lights among the sixteen lights the model pass lights, so a seventeenth lamp no longer overwrites the frame before's corners and the glow lights.
The immediate pass records its shapes against the eye of the camera it draws through and the model pass writes each instance against the origin as it goes into the ring, so no frame reads mapped memory back and a shape far from the world's origin keeps its size.
The mirrored view and the reflection probes' faces are noted by their eyes, a frame drawn into render textures alone takes its origin from the first one's eye, the soft shadow's grain turns by whole cells and global illumination tells a light's place apart within a hundredth of a unit, so a mirror, a probe, a softened shadow and a carried lamp far out read as near the world's origin.
The rays and points from the screen on the CPU take a point less the camera's position through the camera turned alone, Vector3Unproject works the view's inverse in doubles, and the picking takes its ray into a mesh's space from its place less the mesh's translation, so a camera far from the world's origin points as near it.
The fog and its decode, the scattering's blur and the depth of field take each pixel's distance from the eye back from the depth through the camera against the frame's origin from its eye, so a room far out in fog through a lens reads as at the world's origin.
Each pass that reads its frame before takes the way from this frame's clip space to the frame before's from the two cameras' eyes and reads the frame before's views against this frame's origin from their eyes, so a camera turning a million units out reads as at the world's origin.
The render origin's three tests that read a pixel's light against another origin hold a count of pixels past a small level and a largest about twice the most read on the RTX 4070 and on Mesa 26.2.4 and 25.2.8, since one tap of a shadow's filter at an edge falls the other way by the places' rounding.
The shadows fitted in places against the render origin, the cascades to each camera's view pushed from its eye and snapped to texels lying in world numbers by the origin's phase, the spot and point lights from their places, every shadow's view pushed and read as fitted, with tests of a cascade's texel far out and across a step, a shadowed room far out and a camera crossing a step.
A program's shader keeps the world numbers it had, world a property over place and the frame's origin that moves the place when set, and the lighting's point-taking functions taking a world point and the origin off it beside the Placed twins the engine's own lighting calls, with a test of a post's shadow read by such shaders near the origin, 300 units out and across a step.
The render origin stood at the window camera's eye rounded to 16 units, each camera's eye noted with its view-projection so every view is pushed from the eye in doubles, the culling, the immediate pass's 3D shapes, the moving entities' velocity and the particles' rows and sorting eye taken against it, and a test reading a room at 4,096, 71,680 and 1,140,736 units out as the room at the origin.
Every place a pass reads in a buffer handed against the render origin in doubles where the buffer is written, with the passes reading places, the convention 265's kernels keep being that a place is the world point less RenderOrigin, a matrix to clip space the origin's translation times the world's and a world point the origin plus the place, and the origin test run at High too.
The render origin laid through the vertex stages at the world's own origin, the instance ring and every pushed view-projection taken against it in doubles with the origin pushed beside, a place handed beside world, and a test reading a scene alike against an origin 64, -32, 128 away.
